Package smart_food_delivery.domain

Class Driver

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.domain.Driver
Direct Known Subclasses:
BicycleDriver, CarDriver, ElectricVehicleDriver, MotorcycleDriver
public class Driver extends Object
Represents a delivery driver in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. This class stores the driver's information, availability, distance, and estimated delivery time. It also provides a general delivery eligibility method that can be overridden by specific driver types.

    • canDeliver

      public boolean canDeliver(double distanceKm, int orderSize)
      Checks whether the driver is eligible to deliver a specific order. The driver must be available, the distance must be finite and non-negative, and the order must contain at least one item. Subclasses can override this method to apply their own delivery restrictions.
      Parameters:
      distanceKm - the delivery distance in kilometers
      orderSize - the total number of items in the order
      Returns:
      true if the driver can deliver the order, otherwise false
